name: Hardware-Assisted Visibility Ordering (MPVO-based)
definition: A method to extract a front-to-back visibility order of volumetric primitives (triangles) by iteratively extracting 'layers' (maximally independent sets of polygons) using hardware depth/stencil buffers, rather than sorting all primitives globally. It relies on MPVO (Multi-Polygon Visibility Ordering) relations for the interior.
summary: Hardware-Assisted Visibility Ordering extracts front-to-back visibility layers of volumetric primitives using graphics hardware buffers, assigning layer numbers directly to avoid explicit sorting and improve performance.
